context_notes: The orchestrator asserted twice, with confidence, that service_rollups already stored the buckets /api/services recomputes and that /api/history proved it at 33x. All of it was wrong: UPTIME_WINDOW_SECONDS (7d) and telemetry_raw_days (7) are the same duration so rollups begin where the window ends (0 buckets inside, 2016 outside, measured); hourly buckets need 30 days and do not exist at 8; and /api/history reads stats_history over 24h, not rollups. The golden fixtures that were called 'the thing that makes this safe' would have HIDDEN it — a route falling back to raw for 100% of the window reproduces those bytes trivially. This is the ninth instance in this project of a guard or claim asserting something it cannot detect, and the first in analysis rather than in a test. The generalizable rule, now earned nine times: verify a premise before decomposing it, especially one handed over as established fact.
